assets.label: Licensed Armaments
assets.motif: a stamped technical blueprint in front of one factory gear; a small approval seal on the blueprint
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single 64x64-pixel national-spirit badge for Hearts of Iron IV Millennium Dawn / Imperia Cold War.
Input image 1 is the STYLE AND FRAME reference. Create ONE new badge with the same circular silhouette, thick plain gunmetal-grey double bevel rim, subtle black outer shadow, flat muted dark burgundy red enamel centre, and ivory-white embossed pictogram with dark thin outlines. Match the small, understated 2000s strategy-game interface rendering of the reference, not a modern app icon.
Replace the central symbol with: a stamped technical blueprint in front of one factory gear; a small approval seal on the blueprint.
Keep the reference badge proportions and its category colour. Front view, perfectly circular, centred, fully visible, occupies about 92% of the square canvas. The complete emblem and rim must fit inside that circle. Make the pictogram very bold and simple so it remains immediately readable at 64 pixels. Restrained shallow relief, minimal texture, no busy scenery, no extravagant metallic ornaments.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the medallion. No square backing, grey pixels outside the rim, rectangular shadows, text, letters, numbers, banners, flags, logos, watermark, glow or photographic background. Do not include any written label. Only one badge.
